reuse.why: Uses the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link body itself is copied rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies the ~50-line upgrade-or-create/sync/notify body of linkEnableBankingAccount and the other linkers, and downloadFintegraTransactions copies the enable-banking/akahu download boilerplate.

placement.why: Handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config and the account type in its own types/models/fintegra.ts, exactly where the tree puts each provider.

scope.why: Only the server-side additions the request needs.

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link flow and a fifth copy of the download flow means any change to linking must now be repeated in one more place.
